messages:
jess: FYI / escalation from AcmeCorp. They saw a spike of 429s for ~30s right after a traffic surge, and their client retried aggressively which caused duplicate order submissions. Customer is worried about duplicate billing. Can eng/sdks weigh in?

sam: Customer repro steps: single frontend sends 8 concurrent checkout requests (same cart) after network flakiness. They use our JS SDK default settings. They reported duplicate order ids in 2/5 repro runs.

jess: Attaching the sample client snippet they used (from the app).
```js
// client code (simplified)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.createOrder(cart);
```
No idempotency key anywhere in app code. They rely on SDK defaults.

kate: Can you paste their SDK version? My guess: old SDK defaulted to 3 retries + linear backoff and didn't automatically add an Idempotency-Key for write endpoints.

sam: They sent SDK v0.8.2 (not the newest).

amir: Quick log excerpt from our proxy for one repro run:
```
[12:03:01] POST /v1/orders  -> 503 gateway timeout
[12:03:01] POST /v1/orders  -> 429 rate_limited (bucket exhausted)
[12:03:01] POST /v1/orders  -> 200 created (duplicate)  order_id=ord_123
```
We can see the client retried immediately; multiple identical requests landed and one succeeded after the 429.

leo: Do we return Retry-After or our rate-limit headers for these 429s? That changes client behaviour.

amir: Our response for burst 429s currently includes X-RW-RateLimit-Reset and X-RW-RateLimit-Remaining. But we don't always set Retry-After when the rejection is due to short-term burst smoothing.

jess: Customer says SDK didn't respect those headers because it used a fixed linear backoff and stopped when attempts exhausted.

kate: Ok, action items from SDK side I propose: 1) default to exponential backoff with full jitter, 2) parse Retry-After and rate-limit headers before retrying, 3) auto-inject Idempotency-Key for POSTs that look like non-idempotent ops (checkout, orders) unless caller provides one.

leo: From runtime side, we should: 1) ensure 429 includes Retry-After when we intentionally smooth bursts, 2) consider short dedup window server-side keyed by client id + payload hash for order endpoints (to prevent duplicate state changes when duplicate requests arrive within N seconds), 3) add metrics to detect spike patterns where the same client id sends near-duplicate payloads.

jess: For immediate mitigation for AcmeCorp: recommend they upgrade SDK to latest (0.10.x) which has opt-in jitter already, and add an Idempotency-Key header as a temporary fix. Provide them sample patch.

kate: Sample patch to client (send them this snippet):
```js
// patch: add idempotency header and backoff helper
const id = generateUuid();
await client.request('POST','/v1/orders',{body: cart, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id }});
// and use retry with exponential backoff + jitter
```
Also: we should document that SDK will auto-add Idempotency-Key for v1 write endpoints in next minor if not provided.

amir: For server-side dedup, small caution: dedup windows can mask real retries (client legitimately resends after real failure). But for checkout flows it's usually safe to dedup by idempotency key or by a deterministic payload hash when no key is provided. Need product sign-off on semantics.

jess: Customer escalation owner: sam will draft customer note with repro, suggested patch, and timeline for our fixes.

sam: I'll send recommended short-term steps and ask them to enable SDK draft with header injection.

kate: Internal SDK ADR: propose default config: retries=5, baseDelay=200ms, jitter=full, maxDelay=10s, respectRetryAfter=true, autoIdempotencyForWrite=true (opt-out). Wants approval from eng and product.

leo: Engineering notes: also consider server-side smoothing improvements (token-bucket with per-customer burst window) and emit 'throttled-burst' event in logs so we can correlate.

jess: Repro checklist for us: 1) run synthetic with 5 concurrent identical POSTs with SDK v0.8.2 and v0.10.x; 2) run with and without Retry-After in 429; 3) validate whether duplicate orders created. Please post results here.

retry-bot: load-test queued: run id 8765 started by amir.

amir: I'll run the synthetic tests and post the results by EOD. Quick note: if we change SDK defaults we should communicate in changelog and set migration guide because some apps relied on prior behavior.

kate: Agreed. I'll draft migration notes and an opt-out flag.

jess: Thanks all. Sam — please loop in the customer's engineering lead once we have the quick patch and repro confirmation.

sam: Will do.

leo: One more ops item: create an alert to detect high duplicate-success rates (same client submitting multiple successful create responses within short window). That should catch regressions early.

jess: Marking this thread as actionable. I'll update after amir's test results. :eyes:
